case.boundary: Identical resident packed 8-bit caller gray/RGB samples to complete fresh independent JPEG bytes. Public EncodeJpeg admission, bounded block/row normalization, color conversion when RGB, transform, quantization, adaptive Huffman/entropy coding, MemoryStream creation/growth and owned output release are timed. Native borrows resident packed samples, reuses codec and private conversion scratch only; every operation processes/encodes all samples and acquires/releases a fresh owned packet. No RGBA staging or alpha flattening in either operation. Input projection, startup, disk I/O, IPC, hashing and quality checks excluded. One CPU; frozen matched-quality packets exact, no quality-number equivalence assumption.

observation.method: Twelve fixed adjacent managed/native pairs with alternating order and the declared fixed batch of complete operations per subject. All pairs retained. Twelve native batches before and after. The conservative bound includes paired log-ratio confidence and every all-actual/upper-outlier-diagnostic managed-mean confidence against the faster before/paired/after native bracket. Native worker excludes IPC; managed includes complete original public benchmark method, output creation/growth/ownership/disposal and delegate dispatch. Setup, fixture decode, JIT and validation excluded equally; native documented wrappers/input/scratch retained. No timing or baseline-setting changes in production.
